scope: Complete N3 recursive-aggregation metadata stage, no recursive proof generation or runtime preissue

limits.gpu_metadata_compiler_port: Deferred; raw field hashing optimized on GPU, numeric metadata compilation remains on CPU

implementation.field_hash: 16 physical lanes / 8 logical words, shared paired S-box helpers; initially selected only on the qualified NVIDIA RTX 5080; existing eight-lane/scalar selection elsewhere
implementation.field_hash_framing: Same initial states, rate-four padding, per-absorption canonicalization, ordered 4096-word tiles and 64-stream/131072-word limits
implementation.registration: One exact encoding; existing SHA3 implementation hashes both original domain-separated streams using caller plus at most one admitted scoped worker. One-worker path remains serial.
implementation.arithmetic: GPU multiply-add/subtract returns both product and accumulator, replaying both original graph operations in the original order
implementation.arithmetic_workspace: 512 output words and eight fixed public metadata slots; all host/device storage admitted before use
implementation.failures: Collective hash validation, status-before-output, scope poisoning and scrubbing preserved; no CPU fallback or GPU retry after failure
implementation.diagnostics: Bounded encoding/hash, field-size, fused-pair and constructor-family timings; test-only pipeline selector
implementation.protocol: No change to hashes, domains, proof layout or graph topology; CPU identity hashing and CPU numeric compiler retained

methodology.phase_medians: computed independently, may not sum to total median
methodology.fixtures: same captured and independently verified public inputs replayed by both versions
methodology.interpretation: metadata wall latency, not RingCT transaction creation or proof throughput; cache rates are software descriptor-cache rates
methodology.extension_reason: Startup variability made the complete-stage target uncertain; all seven pairs retained, no samples discarded
methodology.independent_feature_screen: Seven samples for field hashing/arithmetic and three for registration/all; matched baseline samples; all prior optimizations enabled

diagnostic_methodology: One instrumented fresh process per variant, after table requalification. Timings overlap and are not additive.

initial_table_invalidation.action: Requalified the existing catalog and regenerated both tables; initial cold-table diagnostic runs excluded from performance qualification

apple_source_preservation.check: Required Apple sources exist, are tracked, and match HEAD

validation.cpu_followup_note: Overlaps the full regression suite and includes the new ownership/refusal test
